_comments: CALIBRATION layout for OWCS VOD youtube 8C105lNzLAM (Crazy Raccoon vs
ZETA DIVISION, Champions Clash 2026 Upper Final). Calibrated against
REAL captured frames (t=360-390s) by locating the ult-charge chips
(orange = team A left, blue = team B right) and measuring the portrait
cell to their right: portrait = chip_x + 24px, y=46, 24x24 at 854x480,
uniform pitch 47.5px, B side mirrors A (854-18-46 = 790 = B5 chip).
Values below are those measurements scaled to 1920x1080 native
(x*2.2482, y*2.25); scale_layout_to_frame maps them back to any 16:9
slots_a = Crazy Raccoon (left/team A: HEESANG STALK3R JUNBIN CHORONG
VIGILANTE), slots_b = ZETA DIVISION (right/team B: KNIFE PROPER
MEALGARU VIOL2T SHU), each [x,y,w,h] px at 1920x1080, origin top-left,
tight to the portrait art. Portrait pitch ~106.8px.
anchor stays a PLACEHOLDER on purpose: the frame filter needs a
same-resolution template crop and is allowed to skip honestly until
one is cut; detection does not depend on it.
templates_dir points at this source's own template set
crops — the shared synthetic starter set in templates/ is untouched.

hud_probe._adjust: chips_a/chips_b = the ult-charge % readout above each portrait (same cell as the chip box derived alongside slots_a/slots_b: chip_x = slot_x - 54, same y/w/h). Verified against a real t=365s frame: median sat 108-164, val 188-228 across all 10 cells; sat_min/val_min set with margin below the observed minimum.

anchor._adjust: PLACEHOLDER — cut layouts/owcs_8c105lnzlam-anchor.png from a live-HUD region (e.g. the team nameplate) to activate the gameplay filter.

_portrait_roi_note: Fractions of each slot box that actually hold the hero portrait.
This package's furniture is at the TOP, not the bottom: the
calibrated 54x54 slot opens with a team-tinted bar and the
portrait runs to the lower edge — the mirror image of
owcs_jksix_qwc, whose portrait sits above a player-name strip.
Derived, not guessed: pipeline/portrait_roi.py over 400 real
crops from reports/ingest/cr-zeta-ccuf-m1-scan found rows 0-12
of 54 flat along their own width (within-row variance under 35%
of the median row) while differing sharply between crops, which
is what a tinted bar does and hero art does not. 13/54 = 0.241.
Measured effect, by the test this ROI exists for — build a
template from side-a crops, score it against side-b crops of the
same hero, so a template that describes the SIDE rather than the
hero is exposed:
Four heroes of four improved; median gain +0.267 of correlation.
It also cut this package's leave-one-out false-match rate from
29.7% to 21.0% before any threshold change (see unknown_floor).
_unknown_floor_note: Per-layout override of detect.UNKNOWN_FLOOR (0.35), measured on
THIS package's own footage. owcs_jksix_qwc's 0.60 was NOT copied:
at 0.60 this package still names 3.7% of the heroes it has no
template for, which is above the 2% ceiling in template_validate.
-scan, with portrait_roi applied, against 747 recall probes:
0.65 is where false matches reach zero. The recall side of that
sweep moved 99.5% -> 99.2%, but those templates were cut from
this same footage, so recall here is an OPTIMISTIC upper bound
for pricing the floor and is not a validation result — this
package still has no provenance and remains UNPROVEN. Re-measure
when a second Champions Clash broadcast is ingested.
